title: Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.22883v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current AI energy benchmarks measure consumption per model invocation. For agentic systems, where a single user goal may trigger multistep orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure recovery, the invocation count is an implementation artifact rather than a task property, and per inference normalization misrepresents the energy cost of completing a goal. We present A-LEMS (Agentic LLM Energy Measurement System), a cross layer framework that redefines the unit of AI energy accounting as Energy per Successful Goal (EpG): total workflow energy across all attempts, including failures and retries, divided by successfully completed goals. A-LEMS combines a temporal boundary model, a five layer attribution pipeline mapping hardware signals (RAPL on x86; SPBM and DCGM on ARM) to workflow energy, and a reproducibility protocol binding every measurement to hardware, environment, and runtime configuration. translated_title: 每成功目标的能耗：面向智能体AI系统的目标级能耗核算
translated_abstract: 当前的AI能耗基准测试以每次模型调用为单位来衡量能耗。然而对于智能体系统而言，单个用户目标可能触发多步骤编排、工具调用、重试和故障恢复，调用次数只是实现层面的产物而非任务本身的属性，因此按推理次数进行归一化会歪曲完成一个目标的真实能耗成本。我们提出了A-LEMS（智能体LLM能耗测量系统），这是一个跨层框架，将AI能耗核算的基本单元重新定义为“每成功目标的能耗””：即跨越所有尝试（包括失败和重试）的总工作流能耗除以成功完成的目标数量。A-LEMS结合了时间边界模型、将硬件信号（x86上的RAPL；ARM上的SPBM和DCGM）映射到工作流能耗的五层归因管线，以及将每次测量与硬件、环境和运行时配置绑定的可复现性协议。基于EpG，我们进一步定义了Orch……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出A-LEMS框架，将智能体AI系统的能耗计量单位从“每次模型调用”重新定义为“每成功目标的能耗”，从而更真实地反映包含重试与故障恢复在内的完整任务能耗成本。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes A-LEMS, a cross-layer framework that redefines AI energy accounting for agentic systems from per-invocation to Energy per Successful Goal, capturing the true energy cost of goal completion including retries and failure recovery.
